highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: 16-year-old KVM flaw allows attackers to escape VMs and take over Linux servers and Chinese hackers develop LONGLEASH malware to expand ORB network. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Vidar Stealer Unmasked: Code Signing Abuse, Go Loaders and File Inflation. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Accenture confirms breach after hacker offers stolen data for sale. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
